finding.expected: Keep the shared DOM-scope resolver and production collector byte-unchanged. Define any V5 interactive-control helper locally inside tiktok_pdp_dom_diagnostic.py so the generated script has no dependency on resolver-private symbols. Add deterministic regression that executes or otherwise validates the generated V5 script path sufficiently to prove there is no unresolved isCtrl reference while preserving attach-only, exactly-one-evaluate, V5 schema, root semantics, sanitation and zero live authority.
finding.issue: The V5 price-role script is not executable as authored on the live path. Inside DIAGNOSTIC_SCRIPT, isInsideBtn() calls isCtrl(cur), but isCtrl is declared only inside resolveBoundedPdpDomScope() in the shared TIKTOK_PDP_DOM_SCOPE_JS function body and is not visible in the outer V5 price-role probe scope. On a bounded root containing a currency or price-like candidate, evaluating isInsideBtn(node) can therefore raise ReferenceError: isCtrl is not defined, so the attach-only diagnostic may fail before producing the required schema-V5 price_role_probe. The 292-pass offline suite validates synthetic payloads but does not execute this JavaScript path and therefore does not prove the exactly-one-evaluate live diagnostic semantics required by AC5.
